column1: # PR D's attribution file: the pixels the move of the menus and popovers (Task 11), and of the scroll-handle scrollbars and two
# icons (Task 12), to Ely changes. Format and meaning: docs/testing/bezel-off.md ("The allow table"). Each why starts with the
# first cell of the spec's inventory row that explains the change.
# Two frames change, both the probe's new-tab menu, and each row below is that frame's whole changed box. `ui::scroll` and
# `ui::icons` have no row: no frame of the 94 draws a scrollbar that moved (the Markdown preview, the CI log, the trace tab and the
# thought well are in no capture) or the mention popup's file icon or the sidebar's trash button, so no pixel of the set is theirs.
